coverages.detail: Standard admitted markets often decline LBK high values; placement usually via private-client carriers (Chubb, PURE, Vault, AIG PC, Berkley One, Cincinnati) or surplus lines. Hurricane deductible is % of dwelling limit: offers $500/2/5/10%; at $1M-$3M carrier may offer 3% instead of 2%; at $3M+ need not offer 2%; applies once per calendar year (s. 627.701).

coverages.status: Required for federally backed mortgage in SFHA; Citizens requires flood for dwelling RC >= $400k since 1/1/2026

coverages.detail: Covers rebuild value above NFIP $250k cap; 'standard practice, not an upsell' on LBK. Carriers cited: Palomar, Neptune, Wright Flood. Private flood can beat NFIP on well-elevated homes with 2+ ft freeboard.

coverages.detail: Coverage A must be < $700,000 outside Miami-Dade/Monroe (Manatee included). Proposed $1.5M for Miami-Dade/Monroe was not enacted. A multi-million-dollar rebuild exceeds the cap. Citizens also subject to depopulation and assessments.
coverages.note: A 2024 Senate bill analysis (CS/SB 1106) described raising the cap to $1M with conditions; Citizens' Dec 2025 chart and Hendrickson still state <$700k for most counties - treat $700k as current; needs verification with Citizens.

premium_factors.effect: Credits required by law for roof strength, roof covering, roof-to-wall, wall-to-foundation, opening protection (s. 627.0629). Example: adding rated openings cut best quote ~21% ($13,286 -> $10,501) on a 2026 Osprey file.
Drives NFIP Risk Rating 2.0 and private flood pricing; 2+ ft above BFE opens cheaper private flood.

premium_factors.factor: Hardened construction (post-2002 FBC, hip roof, impact openings, concrete)

premium_factors.effect: Carrier can't refuse solely for roof age if <15 yrs (s. 627.7011(5)).
